en.topic_title: Smog persists across Hong Kong on Wed after authorities warn of ‘serious’ health risk
en.topic_summary:
Unhealthy levels of air pollution have persisted across parts of Hong Kong on Wednesday, after the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) recorded a “serious” level of health risk at monitoring stations on Tuesday.



Air pollution across Hong Kong on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. Photo: aqicn.org.



However, the Observatory said a fresh easterly airstream will arrive at the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday, helping to dissipate the smog.
